integrity.reproducibility: Standalone Python/SymPy verifier with 360 exact-rational configurations
integrity.scientific_basis: Algebraic spline derivation, exact order-statistic transformation, and survival-function inversion

scientific_limitations: Exactly three iid uniform knots and the normalized integral over their random hull; ordinary C2 natural end conditions; no result for fixed-interval integrals, other knot counts, other distributions, or noiseless smooth-function accuracy.
title: Exact positivity probability and Pareto noise instability of three-knot natural-spline quadrature
